DroidAtlas 1.2 · Data review 2026-11-05 · Community tables; official changes separately sourced

DroidAtlas 1.2 · Data update

The production 1.2 design is unchanged. Six cycles through RB40 are community reported, not directly verified. RB36 exact credits are unresolved. Proto-Roller is Legendary. Scourge Prime is Iconic; its class is unknown.

Reported rebirth tables · Official Cycle 6 rework · Official Scourge rule · Official Scourge Prime

Roster additions and Kyber states are reported in the later local build; current completeness and Scourge eligibility still require in-game verification. Scourge is not inferred as historical acquisition of other variants.

Rebirth Planner: choose your Super Rebirth cycle and Rebirth level, then see the three required droids, minimum variants, Credit requirement, and its reported final requirement in the selected cycle. Verify before selling.

Fusion Recipes: browse all 17 in-game-validated Fusion recipes, grouped by resulting rarity.

Alpha 0.5: adds the DroidAtlas Industrial Command visual identity. Rebirth uses the orange command module; Fusion uses the blue command module. This build retains the production 1.2 styling; data changes are documented separately.

Sell badge: the number is the last Rebirth where that droid is required. The badge material/color shows the minimum variant required at that final Rebirth. Sell it after completing the number shown.

Minimum variant means that variant or any higher variant. Stellar is currently the highest standard variant.

Source status: exact requirement rows are currently seeded from the community tracker and remain Pending until promoted. Credit values through RB27 are confirmed unchanged in game.

Droidex records each exact acquired droid/variant historically. Higher variants do not imply lower variants, ownership, or Scourgedex turn-ins. Selling does not clear acquisition history.
